title: The ECG lab
intro: Dr. Adeyemi's teaching fellow has an ECG cart at each bench. First you'll record each other; then you'll read some strips from real practice (anonymized, and redrawn).

steps.say: "Ten electrodes, twelve leads. Limbs first, then the chest. Count the rib spaces: the angle of Louis is your friend."
steps.speaker: Dr. Nia Hughes, cardiology fellow

steps.say: Your partner lies back, you place the stickers, and the cart prints your partner's heart on pink paper. Then you swap.
"Now the ones you'll see on call."
steps.speaker: Dr. Nia Hughes, cardiology fellow

steps.say: "Rate, rhythm, axis, intervals, ST segments. Every time, in that order, and you'll never miss the one that matters."
steps.speaker: Dr. Nia Hughes, cardiology fellow

feedback: "You read like a second-year. Keep it up."
"Good. Practice with the rhythm strips in the library this week."
"Use the same system on every strip: rate, rhythm, intervals, ST. It will come."
